en: Job 4

p.src: 1  Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
u.src: 1  Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

p.src: 2  “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

ja: もし誰かがあえてあなたに
りかけたら、あなたは悲しむだろうか。 しかし、誰が
るのを抑えることができようか。
en: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
u.src: 2  “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

p.src: 3  Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.

en: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
u.src: 3  Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.

p.src: 4  Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

ja: をしっかりさせてきた。
en: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.
u.src: 4  Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

p.src: 5  But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

ja: 、それがあなたの身に降りかかると、あなたは
落ちする。 それがあなたに
れると、あなたは思い悩む。
en: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.
u.src: 5  But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

p.src: 6  Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

ja: あなたの敬虔さはあなたの確信ではないか。 あなたの道の誠実さはあなたの希望ではないか。
en: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
u.src: 6  Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

p.src: 7  “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

ja: がいただろうか。 あるいは、正しい人が断ち切られたことがどこにあっただろうか。
en: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
u.src: 7  “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

p.src: 8  According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.

ja: てきたところによれば、
en: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.
u.src: 8  According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.

p.src: 9  By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

ja: び、 その怒りの風によって彼らは
en: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
u.src: 9  By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

p.src: 10  The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

en: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
u.src: 10  The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

p.src: 11  The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

en: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
u.src: 11  The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

p.src: 12  “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.

ja: がひそかに私へ届き、 そのかすかなささやきを、私の耳は聞いた。
en: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
u.src: 12  “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.

p.src: 13  In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
u.src: 13  In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

p.src: 14  fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

ja: み、 それが私のすべての
en: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
u.src: 14  fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

p.src: 15  Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

en: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.
u.src: 15  Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

p.src: 16  It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

ja: けることができなかった。
en: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,
u.src: 16  It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

p.src: 17  ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

ja: り主よりもきよいだろうか。
en: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
u.src: 17  ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

p.src: 18  Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.

ja: はそのしもべたちにも
いたちにさえ過ちを負わせられる。
en: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
u.src: 18  Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.

p.src: 19  How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

ja: む者たち、 その基がちりにあり、 蛾よりもたやすく
en: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!
u.src: 19  How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

p.src: 20  Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

en: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.
u.src: 20  Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

p.src: 21  Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’

ja: その天幕の綱は内から引き抜かれ、
en: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
u.src: 21  Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
